     1→import { Router } from 'express';
     2→import { getDb } from '../db/database.js';
     3→
     4→export const operatorsRouter = Router();
     5→
     6→// Search/list operators
     7→operatorsRouter.get('/', (req, res) => {
     8→  const db = getDb();
     9→  const q = req.query.q as string;
    10→  if (q) {
    11→    const pattern = `%${q.toUpperCase()}%`;
    12→    const operators = db.prepare(`
    13→      SELECT * FROM operators
    14→      WHERE callsign LIKE ? OR UPPER(name) LIKE ? OR UPPER(qth) LIKE ?
    15→      ORDER BY callsign LIMIT 50
    16→    `).all(pattern, pattern, pattern);
    17→    res.json(operators);
    18→  } else {
    19→    const limit = parseInt(req.query.limit as string) || 100;
    20→    const offset = parseInt(req.query.offset as string) || 0;
    21→    const operators = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM operators ORDER BY callsign LIMIT ? OFFSET ?').all(limit, offset);
    22→    const total = (db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) as c FROM operators').get() as any).c;
    23→    res.json({ operators, total });
    24→  }
    25→});
    26→
    27→// Get single operator with history
    28→operatorsRouter.get('/:id', (req, res) => {
    29→  const db = getDb();
    30→  const operator = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM operators WHERE id = ?').get(req.params.id);
    31→  if (!operator) {
    32→    res.status(404).json({ error: 'Operator nicht gefunden' });
    33→    return;
    34→  }
    35→  const history = db.prepare(`
    36→    SELECT e.date, e.id as exercise_id,
    37→      GROUP_CONCAT(r.short_name || ': ' ||
    38→        CASE WHEN sr.is_op_marker = 1 THEN 'OP'
    39→        ELSE COALESCE(sr.readability || '/' || sr.strength || COALESCE(sr.db_over_s9, ''), '—')
    40→        END, ' | ') as reports
    41→    FROM signal_reports sr
    42→    JOIN exercises e ON e.id = sr.exercise_id
    43→    JOIN repeaters r ON r.id = sr.repeater_id
    44→    WHERE sr.operator_id = ?
    45→    GROUP BY e.id
    46→    ORDER BY e.date DESC
    47→  `).all(req.params.id);
    48→  res.json({ ...operator, history });
    49→});
    50→
    51→// Quick-add operator
    52→operatorsRouter.post('/', (req, res) => {
    53→  const db = getDb();
    54→  const { callsign, name, qth, bezirk_code, bundesland_code } = req.body;
    55→  if (!callsign) {
    56→    res.status(400).json({ error: 'Rufzeichen erforderlich' });
    57→    return;
    58→  }
    59→  try {
    60→    const result = db.prepare(`
    61→      INSERT INTO operators (callsign, name, qth, bezirk_code, bundesland_code)
    62→      VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    63→    `).run(callsign.toUpperCase(), name || null, qth || null, bezirk_code || null, bundesland_code || null);
    64→    const operator = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM operators WHERE id = ?').get(result.lastInsertRowid);
    65→    res.status(201).json(operator);
    66→  } catch (e: any) {
    67→    if (e.message?.includes('UNIQUE')) {
    68→      res.status(409).json({ error: 'Rufzeichen existiert bereits' });
    69→    } else {
    70→      throw e;
    71→    }
    72→  }
    73→});
    74→
    75→// Update operator
    76→operatorsRouter.patch('/:id', (req, res) => {
    77→  const db = getDb();
    78→  const fields = ['callsign', 'name', 'qth', 'bezirk_code', 'bundesland_code', 'is_bos_arsa', 'is_arena', 'is_portable', 'is_exercise_support', 'gender', 'email', 'equipment', 'antenna', 'has_emergency_power', 'has_lighthouse_readiness', 'latitude', 'longitude'];
    79→  const updates: string[] = [];
    80→  const params: any[] = [];
    81→  for (const f of fields) {
    82→    if (req.body[f] !== undefined) {
    83→      updates.push(`${f} = ?`);
    84→      params.push(f === 'callsign' ? req.body[f].toUpperCase() : req.body[f]);
    85→    }
    86→  }
    87→  if (updates.length === 0) {
    88→    res.status(400).json({ error: 'Keine Änderungen' });
    89→    return;
    90→  }
    91→  updates.push("updated_at = datetime('now')");
    92→  params.push(req.params.id);
    93→  db.prepare(`UPDATE operators SET ${updates.join(', ')} WHERE id = ?`).run(...params);
    94→  const operator = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM operators WHERE id = ?').get(req.params.id);
    95→  res.json(operator);
    96→});

     1→export async function apiFetch(url: string, options?: RequestInit) {
     2→  const token = localStorage.getItem('token');
     3→  const res = await fetch(url, {
     4→    ...options,
     5→    headers: {
     6→      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
     7→      ...(token ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } : {}),
     8→      ...options?.headers,
     9→    },
    10→  });
    11→  if (res.status === 401) {
    12→    localStorage.removeItem('token');
    13→    localStorage.removeItem('admin');
    14→    window.location.href = '/login';
    15→    throw new Error('Unauthorized');
    16→  }
    17→  if (!res.ok) {
    18→    const err = await res.json().catch(() => ({ error: 'Fehler' }));
    19→    throw new Error(err.error || `HTTP ${res.status}`);
    20→  }
    21→  return res.json();
    22→}
    23→

     1→import { useState, useEffect, type FormEvent } from 'react';
     2→import { apiFetch } from '../services/api';
     3→import CallsignInput from './CallsignInput';
     4→
     5→interface Props {
     6→  exerciseId: string;
     7→  reports: any[];
     8→  onReportCreated: (report: any) => void;
     9→  onReportUpdated: (report: any) => void;
    10→  onReportDeleted: (reportId: number) => void;
    11→}
    12→
    13→interface EntryForm {
    14→  callsign: string;
    15→  operator: any;
    16→  rapport: string;
    17→  notes: string;
    18→}
    19→
    20→export default function BundMode({ exerciseId, reports, onReportCreated, onReportUpdated, onReportDeleted }: Props) {
    21→  const [bundeslaender, setBundeslaender] = useState<any[]>([]);
    22→  const [bezirke, setBezirke] = useState<any[]>([]);
    23→  const [linkedRepeaters, setLinkedRepeaters] = useState<any[]>([]);
    24→  const [blRepSelection, setBlRepSelection] = useState<Record<string, number>>({});
    25→  const [collapsedBl, setCollapsedBl] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set());
    26→  const [editingId, setEditingId] = useState<number | null>(null);
    27→  const [editForm, setEditForm] = useState<EntryForm>({ callsign: '', operator: null, rapport: '', notes: '' });
    28→
    29→  useEffect(() => {
    30→    Promise.all([
    31→      apiFetch('/api/v1/reference/bundeslaender'),
    32→      apiFetch('/api/v1/reference/bezirke'),
    33→      apiFetch('/api/v1/repeaters'),
    34→    ]).then(([bl, bz, allReps]) => {
    35→      setBundeslaender(bl);
    36→      setBezirke(bz);
    37→      const linked = allReps.filter((r: any) => r.is_linked);
    38→      setLinkedRepeaters(linked);
    39→      // Initialize per-BL defaults: first linked in that BL, else first overall
    40→      const defaults: Record<string, number> = {};
    41→      for (const b of bl) {
    42→        const inBl = linked.find((r: any) => r.bundesland_code === b.code);
    43→        defaults[b.code] = inBl ? inBl.id : (linked[0]?.id ?? 0);
    44→      }
    45→      setBlRepSelection(defaults);
    46→    }).catch(() => {});
    47→  }, []);
    48→
    49→  const toggleBl = (code: string) => {
    50→    setCollapsedBl(prev => {
    51→      const next = new Set(prev);
    52→      if (next.has(code)) next.delete(code); else next.add(code);
    53→      return next;
    54→    });
    55→  };
    56→
    57→  const parseRapport = (raw: string) => {
    58→    const match = raw.match(/^(\d)\/(\d)(.*)$/);
    59→    if (!match) return { readability: null, strength: null, db_over_s9: null };
    60→    return {
    61→      readability: parseInt(match[1]),
    62→      strength: parseInt(match[2]),
    63→      db_over_s9: match[3]?.trim() || null,
    64→    };
    65→  };
    66→
    67→  const handleBezirkSubmit = async (bezirkCode: string, bundeslandCode: string, form: EntryForm) => {
    68→    if (!form.operator) return;
    69→    const repeaterId = blRepSelection[bundeslandCode];
    70→    if (!repeaterId) return;
    71→
    72→    const parsed = parseRapport(form.rapport);
    73→
    74→    try {
    75→      const report = await apiFetch(`/api/v1/exercises/${exerciseId}/reports`, {
    76→        method: 'POST',
    77→        body: JSON.stringify({
    78→          operator_id: form.operator.id,
    79→          repeater_id: repeaterId,
    80→          ...parsed,
    81→          notes: form.notes || null,
    82→        }),
    83→      });
    84→      onReportCreated(report);
    85→    } catch (err: any) {
    86→      if (err.message?.includes('existiert')) {
    87→        const existing = reports.find(r => r.operator_id === form.operator.id && r.repeater_id === repeaterId);
    88→        if (existing) {
    89→          const updated = await apiFetch(`/api/v1/exercises/${exerciseId}/reports/${existing.id}`, {
    90→            method: 'PATCH',
    91→            body: JSON.stringify({ ...parsed, notes: form.notes || null }),
    92→          });
    93→          onReportUpdated(updated);
    94→        }
    95→      }
    96→    }
    97→  };
    98→
    99→  const handleEdit = (report: any) => {
   100→    setEditingId(report.id);
   101→    setEditForm({
   102→      callsign: report.callsign,
   103→      operator: { id: report.operator_id, callsign: report.callsign },
   104→      rapport: report.readability && report.strength ? `${report.readability}/${report.strength}${report.db_over_s9 || ''}` : '',
   105→      notes: report.notes || '',
   106→    });
   107→  };
   108→
   109→  const handleUpdate = async () => {
   110→    if (!editingId) return;
   111→    const parsed = parseRapport(editForm.rapport);
   112→    try {
   113→      const updated = await apiFetch(`/api/v1/exercises/${exerciseId}/reports/${editingId}`, {
   114→        method: 'PATCH',
   115→        body: JSON.stringify({ ...parsed, notes: editForm.notes || null }),
   116→      });
   117→      onReportUpdated(updated);
   118→      setEditingId(null);
   119→    } catch {}
   120→  };
   121→
   122→  const handleDelete = async (reportId: number) => {
   123→    if (!confirm('Rapport löschen?')) return;
   124→    try {
   125→      await apiFetch(`/api/v1/exercises/${exerciseId}/reports/${reportId}`, { method: 'DELETE' });
   126→      onReportDeleted(reportId);
   127→    } catch {}
   128→  };
   129→
   130→  const selectedRepIds = new Set(Object.values(blRepSelection));
   131→
   132→  return (
   133→    <div className="space-y-2">
   134→      {bundeslaender.filter(bl => !bl.is_international).map(bl => {
   135→        const blBezirke = bezirke.filter(b => b.bundesland_code === bl.code);
   136→        const selectedRepId = blRepSelection[bl.code];
   137→        const blReports = reports.filter(r => r.bundesland_code === bl.code && r.repeater_id === selectedRepId);
   138→        const isCollapsed = collapsedBl.has(bl.code);
   139→        const reportCount = blReports.filter(r => !r.is_op_marker && r.readability).length;
   140→
   141→        return (
   142→          <div key={bl.code} className="bg-white rounded-lg shadow-sm overflow-hidden">
   143→            <div className="bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2 flex items-center justify-between border-b">
   144→              <div
   145→                onClick={() => toggleBl(bl.code)}
   146→                className="flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer hover:bg-gray-100 rounded px-1 -mx-1"
   147→              >
   148→                <span className="text-xs text-gray-400">{isCollapsed ? '▶' : '▼'}</span>
   149→                <span className="font-medium text-sm">{bl.name}</span>
   150→                <span className="bg-[#0d6efd] text-white text-xs px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full">{reportCount}</span>
   151→              </div>

   154→                  value={selectedRepId || ''}

   158→                  }}
   159→                  onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}
   160→                  className="text-xs border border-gray-300 rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-amber-500"
   161→                >
   162→                  {linkedRepeaters.map(r => (
   163→                    <option key={r.id} value={r.id}>
   164→                      {r.site_name || r.short_name} ({r.callsign || r.short_name})
   165→                    </option>

   167→                </select>

   185→                      onEditChange={setEditForm}
   186→                      onEditSave={handleUpdate}
   187→                      onEditCancel={() => setEditingId(null)}
   188→                    />

   192→            )}
   193→          </div>

   195→      })}

   200→interface BezirkRowProps {
   201→  bezirk: any;
   202→  reports: any[];
   203→  onSubmit: (form: EntryForm) => void;
   204→  onEdit: (report: any) => void;
   205→  onDelete: (id: number) => void;

   207→  editForm: EntryForm;

   212→
   213→function BezirkRow({ bezirk, reports, onSubmit, onEdit, onDelete, editingId, editForm, onEditChange, onEditSave, onEditCancel }: BezirkRowProps) {
   214→  const [form, setForm] = useState<EntryForm>({ callsign: '', operator: null, rapport: '', notes: '' });
   215→
   216→  const handleSubmit = (e: FormEvent) => {
   217→    e.preventDefault();
   218→    if (!form.operator) return;
   219→    onSubmit(form);
   220→    setForm({ callsign: '', operator: null, rapport: '', notes: '' });
   221→  };

   223→  return (
   224→    <div className="px-3 py-1.5">
   225→      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1">

   227→          {bezirk.code}
   228→        </span>
   229→        <span className="text-xs text-gray-500">{bezirk.name}</span>
   230→      </div>
   231→
   232→      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1 mb-1">

   234→          <div key={r.id} className="group">

   238→                <button onClick={onEditSave} className="text-green-600 text-xs font-bold">OK</button>
   239→                <button onClick={onEditCancel} className="text-gray-400 text-xs">X</button>
   240→              </div>
   241→            ) : (
   242→              <span
   243→                onClick={() => onEdit(r)}
   244→                className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 bg-gray-50 hover:bg-amber-50 rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 cursor-pointer text-xs"
   245→              >
   246→                <span className="font-mono font-medium">{r.callsign}</span>
   247→                {r.readability && r.strength && (
   248→                  <span className="text-gray-500">{r.readability}/{r.strength}{r.db_over_s9 || ''}</span>
   249→                )}
   250→                {r.notes && <span className="text-amber-600">({r.notes})</span>}
   251→                <button
   252→                  onClick={e => { e.stopPropagation(); onDelete(r.id); }}
   253→                  className="text-red-400 hover:text-red-600 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100"
   254→                >
   255→                  x
   256→                </button>
   257→              </span>
   258→            )}
   259→          </div>
   260→        ))}
   261→      </div>
   262→
   263→      <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="flex items-center gap-1">
   264→        <CallsignInput
   265→          value={form.callsign}
   266→          onChange={v => setForm(f => ({ ...f, callsign: v }))}
   267→          onSelect={op => setForm(f => ({ ...f, operator: op, callsign: op.callsign }))}
   268→          className="w-28"
   269→        />
   270→        <input
   271→          type="text"
   272→          value={form.rapport}
   273→          onChange={e => setForm(f => ({ ...f, rapport: e.target.value.toUpperCase() }))}
   274→          placeholder="5/9"
   275→          className="border border-gray-300 rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-xs w-20 focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-amber-500"
   276→          onKeyDown={e => {
   277→            if (e.altKey && e.key >= '1' && e.key <= '9') {
   278→              e.preventDefault();

   283→        <input

   287→          placeholder="Sonst."

   289→        />
   290→        <button type="submit" className="bg-[#5b3a1a] hover:bg-[#7a5230] text-white px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-xs">
   291→          +
   292→        </button>
   293→      </form>
   294→    </div>
   295→  );
   296→}

key={r.id} value={r.id}>\n                {r.site_name || r.short_name}\n              </option>\n            ))}\n          </select>\n        )}\n        <CallsignInput\n          value={form.callsign}\n          onChange={v => setForm(f => ({ ...f, callsign: v }))}\n          onSelect={op => setForm(f => ({ ...f, operator: op, callsign: op.callsign }))}\n          className=\"w-28\"\n        />\n        <input\n          type=\"text\"\n          value={form.rapport}\n          onChange={e => setForm(f => ({ ...f, rapport: e.target.value.toUpperCase() }))}\n          placeholder=\"5/9\"\n          className=\"border border-gray-300 rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-xs w-20 focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-amber-500\"\n          onKeyDown={e => {\n            if (e.altKey && e.key >= '1' && e.key <= '9') {\n              e.preventDefault();\n              setForm(f => ({ ...f, rapport: `5/${e.key}` }));\n            }\n          }}\n        />\n        <input\n          type=\"text\"\n          value={form.notes}\n          onChange={e => setForm(f => ({ ...f, notes: e.target.value }))}\n          placeholder=\"Sonst.\"\n          className=\"border border-gray-300 rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 text-xs flex-1 min-w-[60px] focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-amber-500\"\n        />\n        <button type=\"submit\" className=\"bg-[#5b3a1a] hover:bg-[#7a5230] text-white px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-xs\">\n          +\n        </button>\n      </form>\n    </div>\n  );\n}"
}

     1→export async function apiFetch(url: string, options?: RequestInit) {
     2→  const token = localStorage.getItem('token');
     3→  const res = await fetch(url, {
     4→    ...options,
     5→    headers: {
     6→      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
     7→      ...(token ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } : {}),
     8→      ...options?.headers,
     9→    },
    10→  });
    11→  if (res.status === 401) {
    12→    localStorage.removeItem('token');
    13→    localStorage.removeItem('admin');
    14→    window.location.href = '/login';
    15→    throw new Error('Unauthorized');
    16→  }
    17→  if (!res.ok) {
    18→    const err = await res.json().catch(() => ({ error: 'Fehler' }));
    19→    throw new Error(err.error || `HTTP ${res.status}`);
    20→  }
    21→  return res.json();
    22→}

     2→import { apiFetch, getOrCreateOperator } from '../services/api';
     3→import CallsignInput from './CallsignInput';
     4→
     5→interface Props {
     6→  exerciseId: string;
     7→  reports: any[];
     8→  onReportCreated: (report: any) => void;
     9→  onReportUpdated: (report: any) => void;
    10→  onReportDeleted: (reportId: number) => void;
    11→}
    12→
    13→interface EntryForm {
    14→  callsign: string;
    15→  operator: any;
    16→  rapport: string;
    17→  notes: string;
    18→}
    19→
    20→export default function BundMode({ exerciseId, reports, onReportCreated, onReportUpdated, onReportDeleted }: Props) {
    21→  const [bundeslaender, setBundeslaender] = useState<any[]>([]);
    22→  const [bezirke, setBezirke] = useState<any[]>([]);
    23→  const [linkedRepeaters, setLinkedRepeaters] = useState<any[]>([]);
    24→  const [blRepSelection, setBlRepSelection] = useState<Record<string, number>>({});
    25→  const [collapsedBl, setCollapsedBl] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set());
    26→  const [editingId, setEditingId] = useState<number | null>(null);
    27→  const [editForm, setEditForm] = useState<EntryForm>({ callsign: '', operator: null, rapport: '', notes: '' });
    28→
    29→  useEffect(() => {
    30→    Promise.all([
    31→      apiFetch('/api/v1/reference/bundeslaender'),
    32→      apiFetch('/api/v1/reference/bezirke'),
    33→      apiFetch('/api/v1/repeaters'),
    34→    ]).then(([bl, bz, allReps]) => {
    35→      setBundeslaender(bl);
    36→      setBezirke(bz);
    37→      const linked = allReps.filter((r: any) => r.is_linked);
    38→      setLinkedRepeaters(linked);
    39→      // Initialize per-BL defaults: first linked in that BL, else first overall
    40→      const defaults: Record<string, number> = {};
    41→      for (const b of bl) {
    42→        const inBl = linked.find((r: any) => r.bundesland_code === b.code);
    43→        defaults[b.code] = inBl ? inBl.id : (linked[0]?.id ?? 0);
    44→      }
    45→      setBlRepSelection(defaults);
    46→    }).catch(() => {});
    47→  }, []);
    48→
    49→  const toggleBl = (code: string) => {
    50→    setCollapsedBl(prev => {
    51→      const next = new Set(prev);
    52→      if (next.has(code)) next.delete(code); else next.add(code);
    53→      return next;
    54→    });
    55→  };
    56→
    57→  const parseRapport = (raw: string) => {
    58→    const match = raw.match(/^(\d)\/(\d)(.*)$/);
    59→    if (!match) return { readability: null, strength: null, db_over_s9: null };
    60→    return {
    61→      readability: parseInt(match[1]),
    62→      strength: parseInt(match[2]),
    63→      db_over_s9: match[3]?.trim() || null,
    64→    };
    65→  };
    66→
    67→  const handleBezirkSubmit = async (bezirkCode: string, repeaterId: number, form: EntryForm) => {
    68→    if (!repeaterId) return;
    69→    const operator = await getOrCreateOperator(form.callsign, form.operator);
    70→    if (!operator) return;
    71→
    72→    const parsed = parseRapport(form.rapport);
    73→
    74→    try {
    75→      const report = await apiFetch(`/api/v1/exercises/${exerciseId}/reports`, {
    76→        method: 'POST',
    77→        body: JSON.stringify({
    78→          operator_id: operator.id,
    79→          repeater_id: repeaterId,
    80→          ...parsed,
    81→          notes: form.notes || null,
    82→        }),
    83→      });
    84→      onReportCreated(report);
    85→    } catch (err: any) {
    86→      if (err.message?.includes('existiert')) {
    87→        const existing = reports.find(r => r.operator_id === operator.id && r.repeater_id === repeaterId);
    88→        if (existing) {
    89→          const updated = await apiFetch(`/api/v1/exercises/${exerciseId}/reports/${existing.id}`, {
    90→            method: 'PATCH',
    91→            body: JSON.stringify({ ...parsed, notes: form.notes || null }),
    92→          });
    93→          onReportUpdated(updated);
    94→        }
    95→      }
    96→    }
    97→  };
    98→
    99→  const handleEdit = (report: any) => {
   100→    setEditingId(report.id);
   101→    setEditForm({
   102→      callsign: report.callsign,
   103→      operator: { id: report.operator_id, callsign: report.callsign },
   104→      rapport: report.readability && report.strength ? `${report.readability}/${report.strength}${report.db_over_s9 || ''}` : '',
   105→      notes: report.notes || '',
   106→    });
   107→  };
   108→
   109→  const handleUpdate = async () => {
   110→    if (!editingId) return;
   111→    const parsed = parseRapport(editForm.rapport);
   112→    try {
   113→      const updated = await apiFetch(`/api/v1/exercises/${exerciseId}/reports/${editingId}`, {
   114→        method: 'PATCH',
   115→        body: JSON.stringify({ ...parsed, notes: editForm.notes || null }),
   116→      });
   117→      onReportUpdated(updated);
   118→      setEditingId(null);
   119→    } catch {}
   120→  };
   121→
   122→  const handleDelete = async (reportId: number) => {
   123→    if (!confirm('Rapport löschen?')) return;
   124→    try {
   125→      await apiFetch(`/api/v1/exercises/${exerciseId}/reports/${reportId}`, { method: 'DELETE' });
   126→      onReportDeleted(reportId);
   127→    } catch {}
   128→  };
   129→
   130→  return (
   131→    <div className="space-y-2">
   132→      {bundeslaender.filter(bl => !bl.is_international).map(bl => {
   133→        const blBezirke = bezirke.filter(b => b.bundesland_code === bl.code);
   134→        const defaultRepId = blRepSelection[bl.code] || 0;
   135→        const blReports = reports.filter(r => r.bundesland_code === bl.code);
   136→        const isCollapsed = collapsedBl.has(bl.code);
   137→        const reportCount = blReports.filter(r => !r.is_op_marker && r.readability).length;
   138→
   139→        return (
   140→          <div key={bl.code} className="bg-white rounded-lg shadow-sm overflow-hidden">
   141→            <div
   142→              onClick={() => toggleBl(bl.code)}
   143→              className="bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2 flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer hover:bg-gray-100 border-b"
   144→            >
   145→              <span className="text-xs text-gray-400">{isCollapsed ? '▶' : '▼'}</span>
   146→              <span className="font-medium text-sm">{bl.name}</span>
   147→              <span className="bg-[#0d6efd] text-white text-xs px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full">{reportCount}</span>
   148→            </div>
   149→
   150→            {!isCollapsed && (
   151→              <div className="divide-y divide-gray-100">
   152→                {blBezirke.map(bz => {
   153→                  const bzReports = blReports.filter(r => r.bezirk_code === bz.code);
   154→                  return (
   155→                    <BezirkRow
   156→                      key={bz.code}
   157→                      bezirk={bz}
   158→                      reports={bzReports}
   159→                      linkedRepeaters={linkedRepeaters}
   160→                      defaultRepeaterId={defaultRepId}
   161→                      onSubmit={(repeaterId, form) => handleBezirkSubmit(bz.code, repeaterId, form)}
   162→                      onEdit={handleEdit}
   163→                      onDelete={handleDelete}
   164→                      editingId={editingId}
   165→                      editForm={editForm}
   166→                      onEditChange={setEditForm}
   167→                      onEditSave={handleUpdate}
   168→                      onEditCancel={() => setEditingId(null)}
   169→                    />
   170→                  );
   171→                })}
   172→              </div>
   173→            )}
   174→          </div>
   175→        );
   176→      })}
   177→    </div>
   178→  );
   179→}
   180→
   181→interface BezirkRowProps {
   182→  bezirk: any;
   183→  reports: any[];
   184→  linkedRepeaters: any[];
   185→  defaultRepeaterId: number;
   186→  onSubmit: (repeaterId: number, form: EntryForm) => void;
   187→  onEdit: (report: any) => void;
   188→  onDelete: (id: number) => void;
   189→  editingId: number | null;
   190→  editForm: EntryForm;
   191→  onEditChange: (form: EntryForm) => void;
   192→  onEditSave: () => void;
   193→  onEditCancel: () => void;
   194→}
   195→
   196→function BezirkRow({ bezirk, reports, linkedRepeaters, defaultRepeaterId, onSubmit, onEdit, onDelete, editingId, editForm, onEditChange, onEditSave, onEditCancel }: BezirkRowProps) {
   197→  const [form, setForm] = useState<EntryForm>({ callsign: '', operator: null, rapport: '', notes: '' });
   198→  const [repeaterId, setRepeaterId] = useState(defaultRepeaterId);
   199→
   200→  useEffect(() => {
   201→    if (defaultRepeaterId && !repeaterId) setRepeaterId(defaultRepeaterId);
   202→  }, [defaultRepeaterId]);
   203→
   204→  const handleSubmit = (e: FormEvent) => {
   205→    e.preventDefault();
   206→    if ((!form.operator && !form.callsign) || !repeaterId) return;
   207→    onSubmit(repeaterId, form);
   208→    setForm({ callsign: '', operator: null, rapport: '', notes: '' });
   209→  };
   210→
   211→  return (
   212→    <div className="px-3 py-1.5">
   213→      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1">
   214→        <span className={`text-xs font-mono px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-white ${bezirk.is_capital ? 'bg-[#dc3545]' : 'bg-[#6c757d]'}`}>
   215→          {bezirk.code}
   216→        </span>
   217→        <span className="text-xs text-gray-500">{bezirk.name}</span>
   218→      </div>
   219→
   220→      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1 mb-1">
   221→        {reports.map(r => (
   222→          <div key={r.id} className="group">
   223→            {editingId === r.id ? (
   224→              <div className="flex items-center gap-1 bg-amber-50 rounded p-1">
   225→                <input value={editForm.rapport} onChange={e => onEditChange({ ...editForm, rapport: e.target.value.toUpperCase() })} className="border rounded px-1 py-0.5 font-mono text-xs w-20" />
   226→                <button onClick={onEditSave} className="text-green-600 text-xs font-bold">OK</button>
   227→                <button onClick={onEditCancel} className="text-gray-400 text-xs">X</button>
   228→              </div>
   229→            ) : (
   230→              <span
   231→                onClick={() => onEdit(r)}
   232→                className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 bg-gray-50 hover:bg-amber-50 rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 cursor-pointer text-xs"
   233→              >
   234→                <span className="font-mono font-medium">{r.callsign}</span>
   235→                {r.readability && r.strength && (
   236→                  <span className="text-gray-500">{r.readability}/{r.strength}{r.db_over_s9 || ''}</span>
   237→                )}
   238→                {r.notes && <span className="text-amber-600">({r.notes})</span>}
   239→                <button
   240→                  onClick={e => { e.stopPropagation(); onDelete(r.id); }}
   241→                  className="text-red-400 hover:text-red-600 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100"
   242→                >
   243→                  x
   244→                </button>
   245→              </span>
   246→            )}
   247→          </div>
   248→        ))}
   249→      </div>
   250→
   251→      <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="flex items-center gap-1">
   252→        {linkedRepeaters.length > 0 && (
   253→          <select
   254→            value={repeaterId || ''}
   255→            onChange={e => setRepeaterId(parseInt(e.target.value))}
   256→            className="border border-gray-300 rounded px-1 py-0.5 text-xs focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-amber-500"
   257→          >
   258→            {linkedRepeaters.map(r => (
   259→              <option key={r.id} value={r.id}>
   260→                {r.site_name || r.short_name}
   261→              </option>
   262→            ))}
   263→          </select>
   264→        )}
   265→        <CallsignInput
   266→          value={form.callsign}
   267→          onChange={v => setForm(f => ({ ...f, callsign: v }))}
   268→          onSelect={op => setForm(f => ({ ...f, operator: op, callsign: op.callsign }))}
   269→          className="w-28"
   270→        />
   271→        <input
   272→          type="text"
   273→          value={form.rapport}
   274→          onChange={e => setForm(f => ({ ...f, rapport: e.target.value.toUpperCase() }))}
   275→          placeholder="5/9"
   276→          className="border border-gray-300 rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-xs w-20 focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-amber-500"
   277→          onKeyDown={e => {
   278→            if (e.altKey && e.key >= '1' && e.key <= '9') {
   279→              e.preventDefault();
   280→              setForm(f => ({ ...f, rapport: `5/${e.key}` }));
   281→            }
   282→          }}
   283→        />
   284→        <input
   285→          type="text"
   286→          value={form.notes}
   287→          onChange={e => setForm(f => ({ ...f, notes: e.target.value }))}
   288→          placeholder="Sonst."
   289→          className="border border-gray-300 rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 text-xs flex-1 min-w-[60px] focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-amber-500"
   290→        />
   291→        <button type="submit" className="bg-[#5b3a1a] hover:bg-[#7a5230] text-white px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-xs">
   292→          +
   293→        </button>
   294→      </form>
   295→    </div>
   296→  );
   297→}
   298→

  "new_string": "export default function BundMode({ exerciseId, reports, onReportCreated, onReportUpdated, onReportDeleted }: Props) {\n  const [bundeslaender, setBundeslaender] = useState<any[]>([]);\n  const [bezirke, setBezirke] = useState<any[]>([]);\n  const [linkedRepeaters, setLinkedRepeaters] = useState<any[]>([]);\n  const [blRepSelection, setBlRepSelection] = useState<Record<string, number>>({});\n  const [blOpCallsigns, setBlOpCallsigns] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});\n  const [collapsedBl, setCollapsedBl] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set());\n  const [editingId, setEditingId] = useState<number | null>(null);\n  const [editForm, setEditForm] = useState<EntryForm>({ callsign: '', operator: null, rapport: '', notes: '' });\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    Promise.all([\n      apiFetch('/api/v1/reference/bundeslaender'),\n      apiFetch('/api/v1/reference/bezirke'),\n      apiFetch('/api/v1/repeaters'),\n      apiFetch(`/api/v1/exercises/${exerciseId}/repeaters`),\n    ]).then(([bl, bz, allReps, exReps]) => {\n      setBundeslaender(bl);\n      setBezirke(bz);\n      const linked = allReps.filter((r: any) => r.is_linked);\n      setLinkedRepeaters(linked);\n      // Initialize per-BL defaults: first linked in that BL, else first overall\n      const defaults: Record<string, number> = {};\n      const ops: Record<string, string> = {};\n      for (const b of bl) {\n        const inBl = linked.find((r: any) => r.bundesland_code === b.code);\n        const repId = inBl ? inBl.id : (linked[0]?.id ?? 0);\n        defaults[b.code] = repId;\n        // Load existing OP callsign from exercise_repeaters\n        const exRep = exReps.find((er: any) => er.repeater_id === repId);\n        ops[b.code] = exRep?.operator_callsign || '';\n      }\n      setBlRepSelection(defaults);\n      setBlOpCallsigns(ops);\n    }).catch(() => {});\n  }, [exerciseId]);\n\n  const saveOpCallsign = async (blCode: string, val: string) => {\n    const repId = blRepSelection[blCode];\n    if (!repId) return;\n    try {\n      // Ensure exercise_repeater exists, then update\n      await apiFetch(`/api/v1/exercises/${exerciseId}/repeaters`, {\n        method: 'POST',\n        body: JSON.stringify({ repeater_id: repId, operator_callsign: val || null }),\n      });\n    } catch {\n      // Already exists, just patch\n      await apiFetch(`/api/v1/exercises/${exerciseId}/repeaters/${repId}`, {\n        method: 'PATCH',\n        body: JSON.stringify({ operator_callsign: val || null }),\n      });\n    }\n  };"
}

Perfect! I have found the relevant code for custom repeater creation. Let me provide you with a summary of the findings:

## Custom Repeater Creation - Code Summary

### Frontend: ExerciseSetupPage.tsx

**Custom Repeater Form** (lines 266-284 for Bundesland repeaters, lines 320-335 for Simplex):
- Form fields: `Name`, `Frequenz MHz`, `Offset MHz`, `CTCSS Hz`, `Rufzeichen`
- Triggered by clicking "+ Umsetzer hinzufügen" (Add Repeater) or "+ Simplex-Frequenz hinzufügen" (Add Simplex Frequency)
- Form inputs stored in state variables: `newRepName`, `newRepFreq`, `newRepOffset`, `newRepCtcss`, `newRepCallsign`

**addCustomRepeater() function** (lines 104-135):
```typescript
const addCustomRepeater = async (bundeslandCode: string | null) => {
  if (!newRepName && !newRepFreq) return;
  const type = bundeslandCode === null ? 'simplex' : 'repeater';
  const name = newRepName || `Direkte ${newRepFreq}`;
  const rep = await apiFetch('/api/v1/repeaters', {
    method: 'POST',
    body: JSON.stringify({
      short_name: name,
      frequency_mhz: newRepFreq ? parseFloat(newRepFreq) : null,
      offset_mhz: newRepOffset ? parseFloat(newRepOffset) : null,
      ctcss_hz: newRepCtcss ? parseFloat(newRepCtcss) : null,
      callsign: newRepCallsign || null,
      band: newRepFreq ? (parseFloat(newRepFreq) > 400 ? '70cm' : parseFloat(newRepFreq) > 200 ? '23cm' : '2m') : null,
      type,
      bundesland_code: bundeslandCode,
    }),
  });
  // Auto-activates the repeater for the current exercise
  // Clears form and closes dialog
};
```

Key logic:
- If `bundeslandCode` is null → type is 'simplex', otherwise type is 'repeater'
- Band is auto-calculated from frequency (>400 MHz = 70cm, >200 MHz = 23cm, else 2m)
- Name defaults to "Direkte {frequency}" if not provided
- After creation, automatically activates the repeater for the exercise

### Backend: repeaters.ts (POST endpoint)

**POST /api/v1/repeaters** (lines 31-58):
```typescript
repeatersRouter.post('/', (req, res) => {
  const db = getDb();
  const { short_name, site_name, band, callsign, frequency_mhz, offset_mhz, ctcss_hz, burst_hz, type, bundesland_code } = req.body;

  if (!short_name) {
    res.status(400).json({ error: 'short_name erforderlich' });
    return;
  }

  const result = db.prepare(`
    INSERT INTO repeaters (short_name, site_name, band, callsign, frequency_mhz, offset_mhz, ctcss_hz, burst_hz, type, is_linked, sort_order, bundesland_code, is_custom)
    VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 0, (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(sort_order), 0) + 1 FROM repeaters), ?, 1)
  `).run(
    short_name,
    site_name || null,
    band || null,
    callsign || null,
    frequency_mhz || null,
    offset_mhz || null,
    ctcss_hz || null,
    burst_hz || null,
    type || 'repeater',
    bundesland_code || null,
  );

  const repeater = db.prepare('SELECT r.*, bl.name as bundesland_name FROM repeaters r LEFT JOIN bundeslaender bl ON bl.code = r.bundesland_code WHERE r.id = ?').get(result.lastInsertRowid);
  res.status(201).json(repeater);
});
```

Key database fields:
- `is_custom` is always set to **1** (true) for custom repeaters
- `is_linked` is always set to **0** (false)
- `sort_order` is auto-incremented
- Requires only `short_name`; all other fields are optional
- Returns the created repeater with bundesland name joined from the bundeslaender table

**Custom repeater display** in the UI shows a purple badge "custom" (line 258, 312) to distinguish them from standard repeaters.

   241→  }, [defaultRepeaterId]);

   245→    if ((!form.operator && !form.callsign) || !repeaterId) return;
   246→    onSubmit(repeaterId, form);
   247→    setForm({ callsign: '', operator: null, rapport: '', notes: '' });
   248→  };
   249→
   250→  return (
   251→    <div className="px-3 py-1.5">
   252→      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1">
   253→        <span className={`text-xs font-mono px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-white ${bezirk.is_capital ? 'bg-[#dc3545]' : 'bg-[#6c757d]'}`}>
   254→          {bezirk.code}
   255→        </span>
   256→        <span className="text-xs text-gray-500">{bezirk.name}</span>
   257→      </div>
   258→
   259→      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1 mb-1">
   260→        {reports.map(r => (
   261→          <div key={r.id} className="group">
   262→            {editingId === r.id ? (
   263→              <div className="flex items-center gap-1 bg-amber-50 rounded p-1">
   264→                <input value={editForm.rapport} onChange={e => onEditChange({ ...editForm, rapport: e.target.value.toUpperCase() })} className="border rounded px-1 py-0.5 font-mono text-xs w-20" />
   265→                <button onClick={onEditSave} className="text-green-600 text-xs font-bold">OK</button>
   266→                <button onClick={onEditCancel} className="text-gray-400 text-xs">X</button>
   267→              </div>
   268→            ) : (
   269→              <span
   270→                onClick={() => onEdit(r)}
   271→                className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 bg-gray-50 hover:bg-amber-50 rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 cursor-pointer text-xs"
   272→              >
   273→                <span className="font-mono font-medium">{r.callsign}</span>
   274→                {r.readability && r.strength && (
   275→                  <span className="text-gray-500">{r.readability}/{r.strength}{r.db_over_s9 || ''}</span>
   276→                )}
   277→                {r.notes && <span className="text-amber-600">({r.notes})</span>}
   278→                <button
   279→                  onClick={e => { e.stopPropagation(); onDelete(r.id); }}
   280→                  className="text-red-400 hover:text-red-600 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100"
   281→                >
   282→                  x
   283→                </button>
   284→              </span>
   285→            )}
   286→          </div>
   287→        ))}
   288→      </div>
   289→
   290→      <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="flex items-center gap-1">
   291→        {linkedRepeaters.length > 0 && (
   292→          <select
   293→            value={repeaterId || ''}
   294→            onChange={e => setRepeaterId(parseInt(e.target.value))}
   295→            className="border border-gray-300 rounded px-1 py-0.5 text-xs focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-amber-500"
   296→          >
   297→            {linkedRepeaters.map(r => (
   298→              <option key={r.id} value={r.id}>
   299→                {r.site_name || r.short_name}
   300→              </option>
   301→            ))}
   302→          </select>
   303→        )}
   304→        <CallsignInput
   305→          value={form.callsign}
   306→          onChange={v => setForm(f => ({ ...f, callsign: v }))}
   307→          onSelect={op => setForm(f => ({ ...f, operator: op, callsign: op.callsign }))}
   308→          className="w-28"

   313→          onChange={e => setForm(f => ({ ...f, rapport: e.target.value.toUpperCase() }))}
   314→          placeholder="5/9"
   315→          className="border border-gray-300 rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-xs w-20 focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-amber-500"
   316→          onKeyDown={e => {
   317→            if (e.altKey && e.key >= '1' && e.key <= '9') {

   319→              setForm(f => ({ ...f, rapport: `5/${e.key}` }));

## 2) Links to Impressum and Datenschutz Pages

- `<a href="#">Datenschutz</a>`

**Datenschutz (German)**: States the site "speichert keine personenbezogenen Daten" (stores no personal data), runs entirely in the browser, uses Cloudflare hosting, and explains user rights under GDPR-equivalent frameworks.

     3→
     4→interface Props {

     6→  onChange: (value: string) => void;
     7→  onSelect: (operator: any) => void;
     8→  autoFocus?: boolean;
     9→  className?: string;
    10→}
    11→
    12→export default function CallsignInput({ value, onChange, onSelect, autoFocus, className }: Props) {
    13→  const [suggestions, setSuggestions] = useState<any[]>([]);
    14→  const [showSuggestions, setShowSuggestions] = useState(false);
    15→  const [selectedIdx, setSelectedIdx] = useState(-1);
    16→  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
    17→  const debounceRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>>();
    18→
    19→  useEffect(() => {
    20→    if (autoFocus && inputRef.current) inputRef.current.focus();
    21→  }, [autoFocus]);
    22→
    23→  const search = (q: string) => {
    24→    if (debounceRef.current) clearTimeout(debounceRef.current);
    25→    if (q.length < 2) { setSuggestions([]); setShowSuggestions(false); return; }
    26→    debounceRef.current = setTimeout(async () => {
    27→      try {
    28→        const results = await apiFetch(`/api/v1/operators?q=${encodeURIComponent(q)}`);
    29→        setSuggestions(results);
    30→        setShowSuggestions(results.length > 0);
    31→        setSelectedIdx(-1);
    32→      } catch {}
    33→    }, 150);
    34→  };
    35→
    36→  const handleChange = (val: string) => {
    37→    const upper = val.toUpperCase();
    38→    onChange(upper);
    39→    search(upper);
    40→  };
    41→
    42→  const handleKeyDown = (e: React.KeyboardEvent) => {
    43→    if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') {
    44→      e.preventDefault();
    45→      setSelectedIdx(prev => Math.min(prev + 1, suggestions.length - 1));
    46→    } else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') {
    47→      e.preventDefault();
    48→      setSelectedIdx(prev => Math.max(prev - 1, -1));
    49→    } else if (e.key === 'Enter' && selectedIdx >= 0) {
    50→      e.preventDefault();
    51→      selectSuggestion(suggestions[selectedIdx]);
    52→    } else if (e.key === 'Escape') {
    53→      setShowSuggestions(false);
    54→    }
    55→    // Keyboard shortcuts
    56→    if (e.altKey && e.key >= '1' && e.key <= '9') {
    57→      e.preventDefault();
    58→      onChange(value + `5/${e.key}`);
    59→    }
    60→    if (e.ctrlKey && e.key >= '1' && e.key <= '9') {
    61→      e.preventDefault();
    62→      onChange(`OE${e.key}`);
    63→    }
    64→  };
    65→
    66→  const selectSuggestion = (op: any) => {
    67→    onChange(op.callsign);
    68→    onSelect(op);
    69→    setShowSuggestions(false);
    70→    setSuggestions([]);
    71→  };
    72→
    73→  return (
    74→    <div className="relative">
    75→      <input
    76→        ref={inputRef}
    77→        type="text"
    78→        value={value}
    79→        onChange={e => handleChange(e.target.value)}
    80→        onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
    81→        onBlur={() => setTimeout(() => setShowSuggestions(false), 200)}
    82→        onFocus={() => { if (suggestions.length > 0) setShowSuggestions(true); }}
    83→        className={`border border-gray-300 rounded px-2 py-1 font-mono uppercase text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-amber-500 ${className || 'w-32'}`}
    84→        placeholder="Rufzeichen"
    85→      />
    86→      {showSuggestions && (
    87→        <div className="absolute z-20 top-full left-0 mt-1 bg-white border rounded shadow-lg max-h-48 overflow-auto w-64">
    88→          {suggestions.map((op, i) => (
    89→            <div
    90→              key={op.id}
    91→              onMouseDown={() => selectSuggestion(op)}
    92→              className={`px-3 py-1.5 cursor-pointer text-sm ${i === selectedIdx ? 'bg-amber-100' : 'hover:bg-gray-100'}`}
    93→            >
    94→              <span className="font-mono font-bold">{op.callsign}</span>
    95→              {op.name && <span className="ml-2 text-gray-500">{op.name}</span>}
    96→              {op.bezirk_code && <span className="ml-1 text-xs bg-gray-200 rounded px-1">{op.bezirk_code}</span>}
    97→            </div>
    98→          ))}
    99→        </div>
   100→      )}
   101→    </div>
   102→  );
   103→}

   298→interface BezirkRowProps {
   299→  bezirk: any;

   312→
   313→function BezirkRow({ bezirk, reports, linkedRepeaters, defaultRepeaterId, onSubmit, onEdit, onDelete, editingId, editForm, onEditChange, onEditSave, onEditCancel }: BezirkRowProps) {
   314→  const [form, setForm] = useState<EntryForm>({ callsign: '', operator: null, rapport: '', notes: '' });
   315→  const [repeaterId, setRepeaterId] = useState(defaultRepeaterId);
   316→
   317→  useEffect(() => {
   318→    if (defaultRepeaterId && !repeaterId) setRepeaterId(defaultRepeaterId);
   319→  }, [defaultRepeaterId]);
   320→
   321→  const handleSubmit = (e: FormEvent) => {
   322→    e.preventDefault();
   323→    if ((!form.operator && !form.callsign) || !repeaterId) return;
   324→    onSubmit(repeaterId, form);
   325→    setForm({ callsign: '', operator: null, rapport: '', notes: '' });
   326→  };
   327→
   328→  return (
   329→    <div className="px-3 py-1.5">
   330→      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1">
   331→        <span className={`text-xs font-mono px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-white ${bezirk.is_capital ? 'bg-[#dc3545]' : 'bg-[#6c757d]'}`}>
   332→          {bezirk.code}
   333→        </span>
   334→        <span className="text-xs text-gray-500">{bezirk.name}</span>
   335→      </div>
   336→
   337→      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1 mb-1">
   338→        {reports.map(r => (
   339→          <div key={r.id} className="group">
   340→            {editingId === r.id ? (
   341→              <div className="flex items-center gap-1 bg-amber-50 rounded p-1">
   342→                <input value={editForm.rapport} onChange={e => onEditChange({ ...editForm, rapport: e.target.value.toUpperCase() })} className="border rounded px-1 py-0.5 font-mono text-xs w-20" />
   343→                <button onClick={onEditSave} className="text-green-600 text-xs font-bold">OK</button>
   344→                <button onClick={onEditCancel} className="text-gray-400 text-xs">X</button>
   345→              </div>
   346→            ) : (
   347→              <span
   348→                onClick={() => onEdit(r)}
   349→                className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 bg-gray-50 hover:bg-amber-50 rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 cursor-pointer text-xs"
   350→              >
   351→                <span className="font-mono font-medium">{r.callsign}</span>
   352→                {r.readability && r.strength && (
   353→                  <span className="text-gray-500">{r.readability}/{r.strength}{r.db_over_s9 || ''}</span>
   354→                )}
   355→                {r.notes && <span className="text-amber-600">({r.notes})</span>}
   356→                <button
   357→                  onClick={e => { e.stopPropagation(); onDelete(r.id); }}
   358→                  className="text-red-400 hover:text-red-600 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100"
   359→                >
   360→                  x
   361→                </button>
   362→              </span>
   363→            )}
   364→          </div>
   365→        ))}
   366→      </div>
   367→
   368→      <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="flex items-center gap-1">
   369→        {linkedRepeaters.length > 0 && (
   370→          <select
   371→            value={repeaterId || ''}
   372→            onChange={e => setRepeaterId(parseInt(e.target.value))}
   373→            className="border border-gray-300 rounded px-1 py-0.5 text-xs focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-amber-500"
   374→          >
   375→            {linkedRepeaters.map(r => (
   376→              <option key={r.id} value={r.id}>
   377→                {r.site_name || r.short_name}
   378→              </option>
   379→            ))}
   380→          </select>

## 1. Gesamtübersicht (Yearly Summary)

**Structure:** 52 rows for every Sunday in 2026 + quarterly subtotals + yearly total

## 2. Exercise Sheet Structure (~1280 rows x 246 cols each)

### Operator Data Columns (A-O) -- static per operator

| Col | Header | Description |
|-----|--------|-------------|
| A | **Rufzeichen** | Callsign (e.g., OE8SSR) |
| B | **Zusatz** | Suffix (p=portable, m=mobil, etc.) |
| C | **Anwesend 1** | Computed: `=IF(AA>0,"1"," ")` |
| D | **Anwesend** | Computed: `=IF(C="1",1,0)` (binary attendance flag) |

| K | **QTH** | Location/city |
| L | **Bez-Kenner** | Bezirk (district) code (e.g., WC, VK, SC) |
| M | **Bundesland** | State (e.g., "01-Wien", "08-Kärnten") |
| N | **Übungs-unterstützung** | Exercise support role |
| O | **safeReach 2023** | safeReach system participation |

### Repeater Report Columns (P-Z) -- vary slightly per exercise

Each exercise has **11 repeater columns** (P through Z). The repeater descriptions include location, callsign, frequency, offset, CTCSS tone, and the OP (operator) for that exercise. Report values are free-text RST format like:
- `5/9 HK` (R5/S9 via Hermannskogel)
- `5/9+30` (R5/S9 plus 30dB)
- `5/9++ GB` (R5/S9 very strong via Gaisberg)
- `3/5 NBST, 5/9 HK, 5/9 JAU` (multiple reports in one cell)

**Repeaters used across exercises (consistent):**

| Col | Repeater/Frequency |
|-----|-------------------|
| P | Gerlitze 2m OE8XNK 145.7625/-0.6 |
| Q | Gerlitze 70cm 439.050/-7.6 SAT 88.5 Hz |
| R | OE-Link: Magdalensberg/Hermannskogel/Schockl/Gaisberg 70cm OE8XMK 438.575/-7.6 SAT 88.5 Hz |

| X | Hochstuhl 439.3625/-7.6 SAT 123 |

Note: The **OP (operator)** changes per exercise (e.g., OE8SSR vs OE8HAM vs OE8GWQ).

### Computed Column: Report Count (AA)

| Col | Header | Formula |
|-----|--------|---------|
| AA | **Anzahl der Rapporte** | `=COUNTA(P:Z)` -- counts non-empty report cells |

### Bezirk Flag Columns (AB-DY) -- ~100 columns

Each column represents one **Bezirk (district)** code. Formula: `=IF(L="WC",1," ")` -- puts 1 if the operator is from that district.

Bezirk codes include Austrian districts (WC, HU, SC, FK, FE, AM, SB, HE, KC, GD, GF, KO, KL, MD, ME, PL, TU, WN, ...) plus international codes (D=Germany, SLO=Slovenia, CZ=Czech Republic, HU=Hungary, CH=Switzerland, LST=Liechtenstein, IT=Italy, HR=Croatia).

### Report Distribution by Bezirk (DZ-HY) -- ~100 columns

| Col | Header | Formula |
|-----|--------|---------|
| DZ | **Rapporte** | `=SUM(EB:HY)` -- total reports check |
| EB-HY | **[Bezirk]2** (e.g., WC4, HU2) | `=IF(L="WC",AA," ")` -- if operator is from that Bezirk, put their report count |

## 3. Summary/Statistics Section (rows ~1052-1165)

### Row ~1052: Column Totals

Key formulas:
- `A1052` = `=COUNTA(A2:A1051)` -- total operators in database (~1050)
- `D1052` = `=SUBTOTAL(109, [Anwesend])` -- total present
- `M1052` = `=P1052+Q1052+...+Z1052` -- total reports (sum of per-repeater counts)
- `P1052` through `Z1052` = `=COUNTA(P2:P1051)` -- reports per repeater
- `AB1052` through `DY1052` = `=SUBTOTAL(9, AB2:AB1049)` -- operators per Bezirk
- `EB1052` through `HY1052` = same pattern for reports per Bezirk

### Rows ~1055-1152: Bezirk Summary Table (the key statistics)

Structure: Column J = "{Bundesland} {Bezirk}", Column K = Teilnehmer (participants), Column L = Rapporte (reports)

- **International:** CZ, Deutschland, Italien, Kroatien, Liechtenstein, Schweiz, Slowakei, Slowenien, Ungarn

### Row ~1153+: Gesamt (Grand Total)

- `K_gesamt` = `=SUM(K1055:K1152)` -- total participants
- `L_gesamt` = `=SUM(L1055:L1152)` -- total reports

1. **Per-Exercise Statistics:**
   - Total participants (Teilnehmer) -- count of operators with at least 1 report
   - Total reports (Rapporte) -- sum of all report entries across all repeaters
   - Reports per repeater -- count of entries in each repeater column

4. **Per-Operator Tracking:**

   - Number of reports per exercise

   - Equipment info (radio, antenna, emergency power, lighthouse readiness)

     3→import { apiFetch } from '../services/api';
     4→
     5→export default function ReportsPage() {
     6→  const { id } = useParams<{ id: string }>();
     7→  const [exercise, setExercise] = useState<any>(null);
     8→  const [stats, setStats] = useState<any>(null);

    10→  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
    11→

    14→    Promise.all([

    17→      apiFetch(`/api/v1/exercises/${id}/nebenstationen`),
    18→    ]).then(([ex, st, nb]) => {
    19→      setExercise(ex);
    20→      setStats(st);
    21→      setNebenstationen(nb);
    22→    }).catch(() => {}).finally(() => setLoading(false));
    23→  }, [id]);

    31→    if (!byBl[n.bundesland]) byBl[n.bundesland] = [];

### Key Takeaways for Web App Replication

1. **Overview charts (LineChart):** Two line series (participants + reports) over time (weekly dates). Three variants: full year, 1st half, 2nd half. These track exercise-to-exercise trends.

2. **Per-exercise bar chart (clustered column):** Two bars per Bezirk showing station count vs report count. Categories are Bezirk labels grouped by Bundesland. This is the geographic participation breakdown.

3. **Per-exercise 3D pie chart:** Shows report distribution across Bezirke. Only uses the "Rapporte" column. This visualizes which regions contributed most reports.

4. **No images, no conditional formatting, no data validation** -- the visual elements are purely charts.

5. The Bezirk category labels use the format `"Bundesland BezirkCode"` (e.g., "Kaernten KL"), which maps directly to your existing domain model of Bundesland + Bezirk codes.

Die Bezirk-Query benutzt `JOIN bezirke bz ON bz.code = o.bezirk_code` — das filtert alle Operatoren ohne bezirk_code raus. Ich mache es so, dass Operatoren ohne Bezirk trotzdem erscheinen, und füge eine Bundesland-Statistik hinzu (die auch ohne Bezirk funktioniert via Rufzeichen-Prefix OE1-OE9).

   298→interface BezirkRowProps {
   299→  bezirk: any;
   300→  reports: any[];
   301→  linkedRepeaters: any[];
   302→  defaultRepeaterId: number;
   303→  onSubmit: (repeaterId: number, form: EntryForm) => void;
   304→  onEdit: (report: any) => void;
   305→  onDelete: (id: number) => void;
   306→  editingId: number | null;
   307→  editForm: EntryForm;
   308→  onEditChange: (form: EntryForm) => void;
   309→  onEditSave: () => void;
   310→  onEditCancel: () => void;
   311→}
   312→
   313→function BezirkRow({ bezirk, reports, linkedRepeaters, defaultRepeaterId, onSubmit, onEdit, onDelete, editingId, editForm, onEditChange, onEditSave, onEditCancel }: BezirkRowProps) {
   314→  const [form, setForm] = useState<EntryForm>({ callsign: '', operator: null, rapport: '', notes: '' });
   315→  const [repeaterId, setRepeaterId] = useState(defaultRepeaterId);
   316→
   317→  useEffect(() => {
   318→    if (defaultRepeaterId && !repeaterId) setRepeaterId(defaultRepeaterId);
   319→  }, [defaultRepeaterId]);
   320→
   321→  const handleSubmit = (e: FormEvent) => {
   322→    e.preventDefault();
   323→    if ((!form.operator && !form.callsign) || !repeaterId) return;
   324→    onSubmit(repeaterId, form);
   325→    setForm({ callsign: '', operator: null, rapport: '', notes: '' });
   326→  };
   327→
   328→  return (
   329→    <div className="px-3 py-1.5">
   330→      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1">
   331→        <span className={`text-xs font-mono px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-white ${bezirk.is_capital ? 'bg-[#dc3545]' : 'bg-[#6c757d]'}`}>
   332→          {bezirk.code}
   333→        </span>
   334→        <span className="text-xs text-gray-500">{bezirk.name}</span>
   335→      </div>
   336→
   337→      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1 mb-1">
   338→        {reports.map(r => (
   339→          <div key={r.id} className="group">
   340→            {editingId === r.id ? (
   341→              <div className="flex items-center gap-1 bg-amber-50 rounded p-1">
   342→                <input value={editForm.rapport} onChange={e => onEditChange({ ...editForm, rapport: e.target.value.toUpperCase() })} className="border rounded px-1 py-0.5 font-mono text-xs w-20" />
   343→                <button onClick={onEditSave} className="text-green-600 text-xs font-bold">OK</button>
   344→                <button onClick={onEditCancel} className="text-gray-400 text-xs">X</button>
   345→              </div>
   346→            ) : (
   347→              <span
   348→                onClick={() => onEdit(r)}
   349→                className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 bg-gray-50 hover:bg-amber-50 rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 cursor-pointer text-xs"
   350→              >
   351→                <span className="font-mono font-medium">{r.callsign}</span>
   352→                {r.readability && r.strength && (
   353→                  <span className="text-gray-500">{r.readability}/{r.strength}{r.db_over_s9 || ''}</span>
   354→                )}
   355→                {r.notes && <span className="text-amber-600">({r.notes})</span>}
   356→                <button
   357→                  onClick={e => { e.stopPropagation(); onDelete(r.id); }}
   358→                  className="text-red-400 hover:text-red-600 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100"
   359→                >
   360→                  x
   361→                </button>
   362→              </span>
   363→            )}
   364→          </div>
   365→        ))}
   366→      </div>
   367→
   368→      <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="flex items-center gap-1">
   369→        {linkedRepeaters.length > 0 && (
   370→          <select
   371→            value={repeaterId || ''}
   372→            onChange={e => setRepeaterId(parseInt(e.target.value))}
   373→            className="border border-gray-300 rounded px-1 py-0.5 text-xs focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-amber-500"
   374→          >
   375→            {linkedRepeaters.map(r => (
   376→              <option key={r.id} value={r.id}>
   377→                {r.site_name || r.short_name}
   378→              </option>
   379→            ))}
   380→          </select>
   381→        )}
   382→        <CallsignInput
   383→          value={form.callsign}
   384→          onChange={v => setForm(f => ({ ...f, callsign: v }))}
   385→          onSelect={op => setForm(f => ({ ...f, operator: op, callsign: op.callsign }))}
   386→          className="w-28"
   387→        />
   388→        <input
   389→          type="text"
   390→          value={form.rapport}
   391→          onChange={e => setForm(f => ({ ...f, rapport: e.target.value.toUpperCase() }))}
   392→          placeholder="5/9"
   393→          className="border border-gray-300 rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-xs w-20 focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-amber-500"
   394→          onKeyDown={e => {
   395→            if (e.altKey && e.key >= '1' && e.key <= '9') {
   396→              e.preventDefault();
   397→              setForm(f => ({ ...f, rapport: `5/${e.key}` }));
   398→            }
   399→          }}
   400→        />
   401→        <input
   402→          type="text"
   403→          value={form.notes}
   404→          onChange={e => setForm(f => ({ ...f, notes: e.target.value }))}
   405→          placeholder="Sonst."
   406→          className="border border-gray-300 rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 text-xs flex-1 min-w-[60px] focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-amber-500"
   407→        />
   408→        <button type="submit" className="bg-[#5b3a1a] hover:bg-[#7a5230] text-white px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-xs">
   409→          +
   410→        </button>
   411→      </form>
   412→    </div>
   413→  );
   414→}

     1→import { useState, useRef, useEffect } from 'react';
     2→import { apiFetch } from '../services/api';
     3→
     4→interface Props {
     5→  value: string;
     6→  onChange: (value: string) => void;
     7→  onSelect: (operator: any) => void;
     8→  autoFocus?: boolean;
     9→  className?: string;
    10→}
    11→
    12→export default function CallsignInput({ value, onChange, onSelect, autoFocus, className }: Props) {
    13→  const [suggestions, setSuggestions] = useState<any[]>([]);
    14→  const [showSuggestions, setShowSuggestions] = useState(false);
    15→  const [selectedIdx, setSelectedIdx] = useState(-1);
    16→  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
    17→  const debounceRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>>();
    18→
    19→  useEffect(() => {
    20→    if (autoFocus && inputRef.current) inputRef.current.focus();
    21→  }, [autoFocus]);
    22→
    23→  const search = (q: string) => {
    24→    if (debounceRef.current) clearTimeout(debounceRef.current);
    25→    if (q.length < 2) { setSuggestions([]); setShowSuggestions(false); return; }
    26→    debounceRef.current = setTimeout(async () => {
    27→      try {
    28→        const results = await apiFetch(`/api/v1/operators?q=${encodeURIComponent(q)}`);
    29→        setSuggestions(results);
    30→        setShowSuggestions(results.length > 0);
    31→        setSelectedIdx(-1);
    32→      } catch {}
    33→    }, 150);
    34→  };
    35→
    36→  const handleChange = (val: string) => {
    37→    const upper = val.toUpperCase();
    38→    onChange(upper);
    39→    search(upper);
    40→  };
    41→
    42→  const handleKeyDown = (e: React.KeyboardEvent) => {
    43→    if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') {
    44→      e.preventDefault();
    45→      setSelectedIdx(prev => Math.min(prev + 1, suggestions.length - 1));
    46→    } else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') {
    47→      e.preventDefault();
    48→      setSelectedIdx(prev => Math.max(prev - 1, -1));
    49→    } else if (e.key === 'Enter' && selectedIdx >= 0) {
    50→      e.preventDefault();
    51→      selectSuggestion(suggestions[selectedIdx]);
    52→    } else if (e.key === 'Escape') {
    53→      setShowSuggestions(false);
    54→    }
    55→    // Keyboard shortcuts
    56→    if (e.altKey && e.key >= '1' && e.key <= '9') {
    57→      e.preventDefault();
    58→      onChange(value + `5/${e.key}`);
    59→    }
    60→    if (e.ctrlKey && e.key >= '1' && e.key <= '9') {
    61→      e.preventDefault();
    62→      onChange(`OE${e.key}`);
    63→    }
    64→  };
    65→
    66→  const selectSuggestion = (op: any) => {
    67→    onChange(op.callsign);
    68→    onSelect(op);
    69→    setShowSuggestions(false);
    70→    setSuggestions([]);
    71→  };
    72→
    73→  return (
    74→    <div className="relative">
    75→      <input
    76→        ref={inputRef}
    77→        type="text"
    78→        value={value}
    79→        onChange={e => handleChange(e.target.value)}
    80→        onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
    81→        onBlur={() => setTimeout(() => setShowSuggestions(false), 200)}
    82→        onFocus={() => { if (suggestions.length > 0) setShowSuggestions(true); }}
    83→        className={`border border-gray-300 rounded px-2 py-1 font-mono uppercase text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-amber-500 ${className || 'w-32'}`}
    84→        placeholder="Rufzeichen"
    85→      />
    86→      {showSuggestions && (
    87→        <div className="absolute z-20 top-full left-0 mt-1 bg-white border rounded shadow-lg max-h-48 overflow-auto w-64">
    88→          {suggestions.map((op, i) => (
    89→            <div
    90→              key={op.id}
    91→              onMouseDown={() => selectSuggestion(op)}
    92→              className={`px-3 py-1.5 cursor-pointer text-sm ${i === selectedIdx ? 'bg-amber-100' : 'hover:bg-gray-100'}`}
    93→            >
    94→              <span className="font-mono font-bold">{op.callsign}</span>
    95→              {op.name && <span className="ml-2 text-gray-500">{op.name}</span>}
    96→              {op.bezirk_code && <span className="ml-1 text-xs bg-gray-200 rounded px-1">{op.bezirk_code}</span>}
    97→            </div>
    98→          ))}
    99→        </div>
   100→      )}
   101→    </div>
   102→  );
   103→}
   104→

Based on the search results, here's what I found about the colors of the Austrian Federal Police (Österreichische Bundespolizei) and their corporate design:

## Vehicle Colors

In Austria, the vehicles of the Federal Police are marked with blue foil and red stripes. 

For the specific blue color used, while the search results don't provide the exact RAL code for Austrian police vehicles, the blue appears to be RAL 5017 (Verkehrsblau/Traffic blue), which is used for police vehicles in the region.

## Uniform Colors

In 2005, as part of the consolidation of security forces in Austria, the green uniforms of the Federal Security Guard and the gray uniforms of the Federal Gendarmerie were replaced by a new dark blue uniform of the unified Federal Police. The red distinctions (rank insignia) were chosen to complement the darker blue tone.

## Corporate Design Elements

The Austrian Federal Police corporate design incorporates:
- **Primary color**: Dark blue (for uniforms and vehicles)
- **Accent color**: Red (for distinctions and vehicle markings)
- **Additional element**: Silver/white striping for visibility on vehicles

Unfortunately, the search results do not provide the complete hex color codes or all specific RAL numbers for the Austrian police's official corporate design. For the most precise technical specifications (hex codes, exact RAL numbers), you may need to contact the Austrian Federal Ministry of Interior (Bundesministerium für Inneres) directly or access their official corporate design guidelines.

Deployed. Here's the color scheme now:

**Blue (primary `#1e3a5f`)** — matches Austrian police blue:
- Navigation bar, table headers, tab active states, headings, chart primary bars

**Red (accent `#c8102e`)** — Austrian police/flag red:
- Action buttons ("+ Neue Übung", "Eintragen", "+", "Hinzufügen")
- "Aktuell" badge, export buttons, "Auswertung" link
- Chart secondary bars (Rapporte), active Bundesland borders, checkboxes
- Logout button

The blue-red combination matches the Austrian Bundespolizei color scheme. Refresh with Ctrl+Shift+R to see it.

Sources:
- [Federal Police (Austria) - Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Federal_Police_(Austria))
- [Austria flag colors](https://colorswall.com/palette/295)
- [BMI Polizeiuniform](https://www.bmi.gv.at/magazin/2021_07_08/Polizeiuniform.aspx)

     1→import { useState, useRef, useEffect } from 'react';
     2→import { apiFetch } from '../services/api';
     3→
     4→interface Props {
     5→  value: string;
     6→  onChange: (value: string) => void;
     7→  onSelect: (operator: any) => void;
     8→  autoFocus?: boolean;
     9→  className?: string;
    10→}
    11→
    12→export default function CallsignInput({ value, onChange, onSelect, autoFocus, className }: Props) {
    13→  const [suggestions, setSuggestions] = useState<any[]>([]);
    14→  const [showSuggestions, setShowSuggestions] = useState(false);
    15→  const [selectedIdx, setSelectedIdx] = useState(-1);
    16→  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
    17→  const debounceRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>>();
    18→
    19→  useEffect(() => {
    20→    if (autoFocus && inputRef.current) inputRef.current.focus();
    21→  }, [autoFocus]);
    22→
    23→  const search = (q: string) => {
    24→    if (debounceRef.current) clearTimeout(debounceRef.current);
    25→    if (q.length < 2) { setSuggestions([]); setShowSuggestions(false); return; }
    26→    debounceRef.current = setTimeout(async () => {
    27→      try {
    28→        const results = await apiFetch(`/api/v1/operators?q=${encodeURIComponent(q)}`);
    29→        setSuggestions(results);
    30→        setShowSuggestions(results.length > 0);
    31→        setSelectedIdx(-1);
    32→      } catch {}
    33→    }, 150);
    34→  };
    35→
    36→  const handleChange = (val: string) => {
    37→    const upper = val.toUpperCase();
    38→    onChange(upper);
    39→    search(upper);
    40→  };
    41→
    42→  const handleKeyDown = (e: React.KeyboardEvent) => {
    43→    if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') {
    44→      e.preventDefault();
    45→      setSelectedIdx(prev => Math.min(prev + 1, suggestions.length - 1));
    46→    } else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') {
    47→      e.preventDefault();
    48→      setSelectedIdx(prev => Math.max(prev - 1, -1));
    49→    } else if (e.key === 'Enter' && selectedIdx >= 0) {
    50→      e.preventDefault();
    51→      selectSuggestion(suggestions[selectedIdx]);
    52→    } else if (e.key === 'Escape') {
    53→      setShowSuggestions(false);
    54→    }
    55→    // Keyboard shortcuts
    56→    if (e.altKey && e.key >= '1' && e.key <= '9') {
    57→      e.preventDefault();
    58→      onChange(value + `5/${e.key}`);
    59→    }
    60→    if (e.ctrlKey && e.key >= '1' && e.key <= '9') {
    61→      e.preventDefault();
    62→      onChange(`OE${e.key}`);
    63→    }
    64→  };
    65→
    66→  const selectSuggestion = (op: any) => {
    67→    onChange(op.callsign);
    68→    onSelect(op);
    69→    setShowSuggestions(false);
    70→    setSuggestions([]);
    71→  };
    72→
    73→  return (
    74→    <div className="relative">
    75→      <input
    76→        ref={inputRef}
    77→        type="text"
    78→        value={value}
    79→        onChange={e => handleChange(e.target.value)}
    80→        onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
    81→        onBlur={() => setTimeout(() => setShowSuggestions(false), 200)}
    82→        onFocus={() => { if (suggestions.length > 0) setShowSuggestions(true); }}
    83→        className={`border border-gray-300 rounded px-2 py-1 font-mono uppercase text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 ${className || 'w-32'}`}
    84→        placeholder="Rufzeichen"
    85→      />
    86→      {showSuggestions && (
    87→        <div className="absolute z-20 top-full left-0 mt-1 bg-white border rounded shadow-lg max-h-48 overflow-auto w-64">
    88→          {suggestions.map((op, i) => (
    89→            <div
    90→              key={op.id}
    91→              onMouseDown={() => selectSuggestion(op)}
    92→              className={`px-3 py-1.5 cursor-pointer text-sm ${i === selectedIdx ? 'bg-blue-100' : 'hover:bg-gray-100'}`}

Now I have a complete picture. Here is my analysis.

---

## Investigation Results: "Adding Rapporte does not work"

I traced the full report submission flow across both client components (LandMode and BundMode), the API service layer, and the server-side route. Here are the findings:

### Finding 1 (CRITICAL BUG in BundMode): Repeater dropdown only shows `is_linked` repeaters

**File:** `/home/achildrenmile/bosarsalog/client/src/components/BundMode.tsx`, line 43

```typescript
const linked = allReps.filter((r: any) => r.is_linked);
setLinkedRepeaters(linked);
```

BundMode fetches **all repeaters** from `/api/v1/repeaters` but then filters to only those with `is_linked = true`. If none of the repeaters in the database have `is_linked = 1`, then `linked` will be an empty array, meaning:

- The `linkedRepeaters` state will be empty.
- The dropdown in `BezirkRow` (line 421-432) won't render because `linkedRepeaters.length > 0` is false.
- The `defaultRepId` for each Bundesland will be `0` (from `linked[0]?.id ?? 0` on line 50).
- When the form is submitted, `handleBezirkSubmit` is called with `repeaterId = 0`. On line 123: `if (!repeaterId) return;` -- this returns immediately, silently doing nothing.

This is very likely the primary bug. If no repeaters are marked as `is_linked`, BundMode completely fails to submit any reports.

Even if some are linked, the dropdown only shows linked repeaters, not the actual exercise repeaters. This is a fundamental mismatch -- BundMode should probably be using the exercise's configured repeaters, not filtering by `is_linked`.

### Finding 2 (Potential issue in BundMode): Exercise repeaters are not used for the form

BundMode fetches `exercise_repeaters` on line 39 but only uses them to look up `operator_callsign` on line 53. It never uses the exercise repeaters for the form dropdown. The dropdown is populated entirely from `linkedRepeaters` (the globally linked repeaters). This means even if an exercise has specific non-linked repeaters configured, BundMode ignores them.

### Finding 3 (LandMode is likely fine): LandMode uses exercise repeaters correctly

**File:** `/home/achildrenmile/bosarsalog/client/src/components/LandMode.tsx`

LandMode receives `repeaters` from props (line 27), which comes from `exercise.repeaters` (ExercisePage line 158). It uses `rep.repeater_id` for submission (line 101). This flow looks correct.

However, LandMode has a secondary issue: if no exercise repeaters have been set up (the exercise has no repeaters configured), `activeRepeaterId` will be `null` and the form submission (line 79: `if (!activeRepeaterId) return;`) will silently do nothing.

### Finding 4 (Silent error swallowing everywhere)

Throughout both components, all `catch` blocks are empty:
- BundMode line 58: `.catch(() => {})`
- BundMode line 101: `catch {}`
- BundMode line 174: `catch {}`
- LandMode line 94: `catch {}`
- LandMode line 122: `catch {}`

This means any API errors (auth failures, validation errors, server errors) are silently swallowed with no user feedback. The user clicks "Eintragen" and nothing happens, with no error message shown.

### Finding 5 (CallsignInput Enter key interaction)

**File:** `/home/achildrenmile/bosarsalog/client/src/components/CallsignInput.tsx`, line 49

When the suggestion dropdown is showing and the user has navigated to a suggestion (`selectedIdx >= 0`), pressing Enter calls `e.preventDefault()` and `selectSuggestion()` instead of submitting the form. This is intentional, but it means the user has to press Enter twice (once to select the suggestion, once to submit the form). This is not a bug per se, but it might confuse users who expect Enter to both select and submit.

### Finding 6 (Server-side route looks correct)

**File:** `/home/achildrenmile/bosarsalog/server/src/routes/exercises.ts`, lines 221-259

The POST `/api/v1/exercises/:id/reports` endpoint correctly:
- Requires `operator_id` and `repeater_id`
- Handles the UNIQUE constraint for duplicate reports (returns 409)
- Returns the created report with JOINed data
- Is protected by `authMiddleware`

The server-side logic appears sound. No issues found there.

### Finding 7 (No server-side errors in logs)

The Docker container logs show only normal startup messages and socket connections -- no error traces, which is consistent with the client silently swallowing errors or never even making the API call (due to the `repeaterId = 0` / `!repeaterId` guard).

---

### Root Cause Summary

The most likely root cause is **Finding 1**: In BundMode, the form relies on `is_linked` repeaters, and if no repeaters have that flag (or the specific Bundesland has no linked repeater), the `repeaterId` defaults to `0`, and `handleBezirkSubmit` exits silently at `if (!repeaterId) return;`. Combined with the empty `catch` blocks (Finding 4), the user sees no error and no report is created.

For LandMode, the flow looks correct as long as exercise repeaters are configured. If the user is primarily using BundMode, that is where the breakage is.

To fix this, BundMode should use the exercise's configured repeaters (from `/api/v1/exercises/${exerciseId}/repeaters`) for the form dropdown instead of (or in addition to) filtering by `is_linked` from the global repeaters list. Additionally, adding user-facing error messages instead of empty `catch {}` blocks would make debugging much easier.

     1→export async function getOrCreateOperator(callsign: string, existing: any): Promise<any> {
     2→  if (existing) return existing;
     3→  if (!callsign || callsign.length < 3) return null;
     4→  try {
     5→    return await apiFetch('/api/v1/operators', {
     6→      method: 'POST',
     7→      body: JSON.stringify({ callsign: callsign.toUpperCase() }),
     8→    });
     9→  } catch (err: any) {
    10→    if (err.message?.includes('existiert')) {
    11→      const results = await apiFetch(`/api/v1/operators?q=${encodeURIComponent(callsign)}`);
    12→      return results.find((o: any) => o.callsign === callsign.toUpperCase()) || results[0] || null;
    13→    }
    14→    return null;
    15→  }
    16→}
    17→
    18→export async function apiFetch(url: string, options?: RequestInit) {
    19→  const token = localStorage.getItem('token');
    20→  const res = await fetch(url, {
    21→    ...options,
    22→    headers: {
    23→      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    24→      ...(token ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } : {}),
    25→      ...options?.headers,
    26→    },
    27→  });
    28→  if (res.status === 401) {
    29→    localStorage.removeItem('token');
    30→    localStorage.removeItem('admin');
    31→    window.location.href = '/login';
    32→    throw new Error('Unauthorized');
    33→  }
    34→  if (!res.ok) {
    35→    const err = await res.json().catch(() => ({ error: 'Fehler' }));
    36→    throw new Error(err.error || `HTTP ${res.status}`);
    37→  }
    38→  return res.json();
    39→}
