     1→import { Request, Response, NextFunction } from 'express';
     2→import jwt from 'jsonwebtoken';
     3→
     4→const JWT_SECRET = process.env.JWT_SECRET || 'dev-secret-change-me';
     5→
     6→export interface AuthRequest extends Request {
     7→  admin?: {
     8→    id: number;
     9→    username: string;
    10→    role: string;
    11→  };
    12→}
    13→
    14→export function authMiddleware(req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction): void {
    15→  const header = req.headers.authorization;
    16→  if (!header || !header.startsWith('Bearer ')) {
    17→    res.status(401).json({ error: 'Nicht autorisiert' });
    18→    return;
    19→  }
    20→  try {
    21→    const token = header.slice(7);
    22→    const payload = jwt.verify(token, JWT_SECRET) as any;
    23→    (req as AuthRequest).admin = {
    24→      id: payload.id,
    25→      username: payload.username,
    26→      role: payload.role,
    27→    };
    28→    next();
    29→  } catch {
    30→    res.status(401).json({ error: 'Token ungültig' });
    31→  }
    32→}
    33→
    34→export function requireRole(...roles: string[]) {
    35→  return (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction): void => {
    36→    const admin = (req as AuthRequest).admin;
    37→    if (!admin || !roles.includes(admin.role)) {
    38→      res.status(403).json({ error: 'Keine Berechtigung' });
    39→      return;
    40→    }
    41→    next();
    42→  };
    43→}
    44→
    45→export { JWT_SECRET };
    46→

Deployed. The key fix: reports now show in the **repeater's Bundesland**, not the operator's. So OE8ABV on Hermannskogel (Wien) will now appear under Wien, not Kärnten.

Also:
- Rapport pre-filled with "5/9"
- Enter submits the form
- Focus returns to callsign after each entry

> DEVELOPER

it works now. what will be stored, if OP is not set?

> AGENT

The OP field is stored in `exercise_repeaters.operator_callsign` — it's just metadata for display (shows as a badge on repeater tabs). It does NOT affect report creation.

When OP is not set:
- **Reports still work** — they store `entered_by` = your login username (e.g. "admin")
- **No OP badge** appears on the repeater tab
- The OP field is `null` in the database

The OP field is independent from the report data. It's just to note who is physically operating at the repeater site during the exercise.

> DEVELOPER

so will see which operator (if set) has done the bundesland like oe1?

> AGENT

Yes, exactly. If the OP field is set for a Bundesland (e.g. "OE1XYZ" for Wien), it shows:

- **BundMode**: in the header row next to "OP:" for that Bundesland
- **LandMode**: as a badge on the repeater tab (e.g. "Hermannskogel 70cm `OE1XYZ`")
- **Stored in DB**: `exercise_repeaters.operator_callsign` — so it's preserved per exercise

This way you can see after the exercise who was operating each Bundesland/repeater.

   311→                                  <>
   312→                                    <td className="py-0.5 text-gray-400 w-4">{idx + 1}</td>

   314→                                    <td className="py-0.5 font-mono text-gray-500 w-24 cursor-pointer" onClick={() => handleEdit(r)}>
   315→                                      {r.readability && r.strength ? `${r.readability}/${r.strength}${r.db_over_s9 || ''}` : '—'}
   316→                                    </td>

   320→                                    </td>

   339→
   340→interface BezirkRowProps {
   341→  bezirk: any;
   342→  reports: any[];
   343→  linkedRepeaters: any[];
   344→  defaultRepeaterId: number;
   345→  onSubmit: (repeaterId: number, form: EntryForm) => void;
   346→  onEdit: (report: any) => void;
   347→  onDelete: (id: number) => void;
   348→  editingId: number | null;
   349→  editForm: EntryForm;
   350→  onEditChange: (form: EntryForm) => void;
   351→  onEditSave: () => void;
   352→  onEditCancel: () => void;
   353→}
   354→
   355→function BezirkRow({ bezirk, reports, linkedRepeaters, defaultRepeaterId, onSubmit, onEdit, onDelete, editingId, editForm, onEditChange, onEditSave, onEditCancel }: BezirkRowProps) {
   356→  const [form, setForm] = useState<EntryForm>({ callsign: '', operator: null, rapport: '5/9', notes: '' });
   357→  const [repeaterId, setRepeaterId] = useState(defaultRepeaterId);
   358→  const callsignRef = useRef<CallsignInputRef>(null);
   359→
   360→  useEffect(() => {
   361→    if (defaultRepeaterId && !repeaterId) setRepeaterId(defaultRepeaterId);
   362→  }, [defaultRepeaterId]);
   363→
   364→  const handleSubmit = (e: FormEvent) => {
   365→    e.preventDefault();
   366→    if (!form.callsign && !form.operator) return;
   367→    if (!repeaterId) return;
   368→    onSubmit(repeaterId, form);
   369→    setForm({ callsign: '', operator: null, rapport: '5/9', notes: '' });
   370→    setTimeout(() => callsignRef.current?.focus(), 50);
   371→  };
   372→
   373→  return (
   374→    <div className="px-3 py-1.5">
   375→      {bezirk.code !== '??' && (
   376→        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1">
   377→          <span className={`text-xs font-mono px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-white ${bezirk.is_capital ? 'bg-[#dc3545]' : 'bg-[#6c757d]'}`}>
   378→            {bezirk.code}
   379→          </span>
   380→          <span className="text-xs text-gray-500">{bezirk.name}</span>
   381→          {reports.length > 0 && <span className="text-xs text-gray-400">({reports.length})</span>}
   382→        </div>
   383→      )}
   384→
   385→      {reports.length > 0 && (
   386→        <table className="w-full text-xs mb-1">
   387→          <tbody>
   388→            {reports.map((r, idx) => (
   389→              <tr key={r.id} className="hover:bg-blue-50 group">
   390→                {editingId === r.id ? (
   391→                  <td colSpan={5} className="py-0.5">
   392→                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1 bg-blue-50 rounded p-1">
   393→                      <span className="font-mono font-medium">{r.callsign}</span>
   394→                      <input value={editForm.rapport} onChange={e => onEditChange({ ...editForm, rapport: e.target.value.toUpperCase() })} className="border rounded px-1 py-0.5 font-mono text-xs w-20" autoFocus />
   395→                      <input value={editForm.notes} onChange={e => onEditChange({ ...editForm, notes: e.target.value })} placeholder="Sonst." className="border rounded px-1 py-0.5 text-xs w-20" />
   396→                      <button onClick={onEditSave} className="text-green-600 text-xs font-bold">OK</button>
   397→                      <button onClick={onEditCancel} className="text-gray-400 text-xs">X</button>
   398→                    </div>
   399→                  </td>
   400→                ) : (
   401→                  <>
   402→                    <td className="py-0.5 text-gray-400 w-4">{idx + 1}</td>
   403→                    <td className="py-0.5 font-mono font-medium cursor-pointer" onClick={() => onEdit(r)}>{r.callsign}</td>
   404→                    <td className="py-0.5 font-mono text-gray-500 w-24 cursor-pointer" onClick={() => onEdit(r)}>
   405→                      {r.readability && r.strength ? `${r.readability}/${r.strength}${r.db_over_s9 || ''}` : '—'}
   406→                    </td>
   407→                    <td className="py-0.5 text-gray-500 cursor-pointer" onClick={() => onEdit(r)}>{r.notes || ''}</td>
   408→                    <td className="py-0.5 w-4">
   409→                      <button onClick={() => onDelete(r.id)} className="text-red-400 hover:text-red-600 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100">x</button>
   410→                    </td>
   411→                  </>
   412→                )}
   413→              </tr>
   414→            ))}
   415→          </tbody>
   416→        </table>
   417→      )}
   418→
   419→      <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="flex items-center gap-1">
   420→        {linkedRepeaters.length > 0 && (
   421→          <select
   422→            value={repeaterId || ''}
   423→            onChange={e => setRepeaterId(parseInt(e.target.value))}
   424→            className="border border-gray-300 rounded px-1 py-0.5 text-xs focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-500"
   425→          >
   426→            {linkedRepeaters.map(r => (
   427→              <option key={r.id} value={r.id}>
   428→                {r.site_name || r.short_name}
   429→              </option>
   430→            ))}
   431→          </select>
   432→        )}
   433→        <CallsignInput
   434→          ref={callsignRef}
   435→          value={form.callsign}
   436→          onChange={v => setForm(f => ({ ...f, callsign: v }))}
   437→          onSelect={op => setForm(f => ({ ...f, operator: op, callsign: op.callsign }))}
   438→          className="w-28"
   439→        />
   440→        <input
   441→          type="text"
   442→          value={form.rapport}
   443→          onChange={e => setForm(f => ({ ...f, rapport: e.target.value.toUpperCase() }))}
   444→          placeholder="5/9"
   445→          className="border border-gray-300 rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-xs w-20 focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-500"
   446→          onKeyDown={e => {
   447→            if (e.altKey && e.key >= '1' && e.key <= '9') {
   448→              e.preventDefault();
   449→              setForm(f => ({ ...f, rapport: `5/${e.key}` }));
   450→            }
   451→          }}
   452→        />
   453→        <input
   454→          type="text"
   455→          value={form.notes}
   456→          onChange={e => setForm(f => ({ ...f, notes: e.target.value }))}
   457→          placeholder="Sonst."
   458→          className="border border-gray-300 rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 text-xs flex-1 min-w-[60px] focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-500"
   459→        />
   460→        <button type="submit" className="bg-[#c8102e] hover:bg-[#a00d24] text-white px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-xs">
   461→          +
   462→        </button>
   463→      </form>
   464→    </div>
   465→  );
   466→}

  "content": "# LandMode Refactoring: Repeater-Grid wie BundMode\n\n## Context\nLandMode (Umsetzer-Ansicht) nutzt aktuell ein Tab-basiertes Layout mit einem einzigen Eingabeformular oben und einer Liste aller Repeater mit ihren Reports darunter. Der User möchte, dass LandMode exakt wie BundMode funktioniert — aber statt Bundesländer als Hauptkategorien werden **Repeater** als Hauptkategorien verwendet. Jede Repeater-Karte hat ein eigenes OP-Feld im Header und ein eigenes Eingabeformular für Rapporte direkt in der Karte.\n\n## Änderungen\n\n### 1. LandMode komplett umschreiben\n**Datei:** `client/src/components/LandMode.tsx`\n\n**Struktur (analog zu BundMode):**\n- Repeaters gruppiert nach Bundesland (wie jetzt in den Tabs), aber jeder Repeater wird eine eigene **collapsible card** (wie Bundesland-Karten in BundMode)\n- Pro Repeater-Card:\n  - **Header**: Repeater-Name, OP-Rufzeichen-Input, Report-Count-Badge, Frequenz-Info, Collapse-Toggle\n  - **Body**: Report-Liste (Tabelle) + Eingabeformular am Ende\n- **Eingabeformular pro Repeater** (wie `BezirkRow` in BundMode):\n  - CallsignInput + Rapport (vorausgefüllt \"5/9\") + Notes + Submit-Button\n  - Enter zum Eintragen, Auto-Focus zurück auf Callsign nach Submit\n- **Cross-Repeater-Sync entfernen**: Keine Placeholder-Einträge mehr auf anderen Repeatern\n\n**Reuse von BundMode-Patterns:**\n- `parseRapport()` — identische Funktion\n- `CallsignInput` mit ref für Auto-Focus — selbes Pattern wie in `BezirkRow`\n- `EntryForm` interface — identisch\n- Collapsible-State via `Set<number>` (Repeater-IDs statt BL-Codes)\n- OP-Callsign speichern via `saveOpCallsign()` — selbes API-Pattern\n\n**Neues Sub-Component `RepeaterRow`** (analog zu `BezirkRow`):\n- Props: repeater, reports, exerciseId, onReportCreated, onReportUpdated, onReportDeleted, editingId, editForm, onEditChange, onEditSave, onEditCancel\n- Eigenes `form` State mit `{ callsign, operator, rapport: '5/9', notes: '' }`\n- Submit erstellt Report direkt auf diesem Repeater\n- Report-Liste als Tabelle (Zeilen: Index, Callsign, Bezirk-Badge, Rapport, Notes, Delete)\n\n**Layout-Änderungen:**\n- Entferne Tab-Navigation komplett\n- Entferne globales Eingabeformular\n- Repeater als Cards gruppiert nach BL-Header (kleine Überschriften wie \"OE1 Wien\", \"OE2 Salzburg\")\n- Jede Card: Header klickbar zum Collapse/Expand\n\n### Keine Server-Änderungen nötig\nDie API bleibt unverändert — LandMode nutzt dieselben Endpoints wie bisher.\n\n## Verifizierung\n1. `nix-shell -p nodejs --run \"npm run build\"` kompiliert\n2. LandMode zeigt Repeater als Cards gruppiert nach Bundesland\n3. Jede Card hat OP-Feld, Report-Liste, Eingabeformular\n4. Rapport vorausgefüllt mit \"5/9\", Enter submitted, Auto-Focus auf Callsign\n5. Kein Cross-Repeater-Sync (nur der eine Repeater bekommt den Report)\n6. Deploy auf host-node-01\n"
}
